Name: Fishing Trainer
Author: WindmillCity
Description:
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
1. Download.
2. Unzip and Put it in your StardewValley/Mods folder.
3. Press [b]F8[/b] in game to open FishingGame menu.
4. Press [b]F9[/b] in game to reset the FishingGame status.

[size=4][b]Config[/b][/size]
1. Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
2. Adapt what you want.

[size=4][b]安装[/b][/size]
1. 下载
2. 将 Mod 解压并放到 StardewValley/Mods 目录
3. 按 [b]F8[/b] 打开练习器
4. 按 [b]F9[/b] 复位练习器状态

[b][size=4]配置[/size][/b]
1. 下载 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
2. 修改你需要的数据
